data.text: Waddle! We are finally at the FARM. The air is so fresh here in the RURAL area. Kiki, what is our first CHORE?

data.speaker: kiki
data.text: Meow! We need to help with the milking. It is part of our daily ROUTINE. After that, we can TOUR the banana plantation!

data.speaker: polly
data.text: SQUAWK! Manya, you look so EXCITED. That's because the village is EXCITING! We must use the right Adjective suffixes.

rules.title: Feelings vs. Descriptions
rules.explainA: Use -ed to describe how a person (or duck!) feels.
rules.explainB: Use -ing to describe the thing that causes the feeling.
rules.teacherNote: PLE TRAP: Do not say 'The trip was excited'. The trip is EXCITING!

questions.prompt: The story was very _______ (interest).
Kiki felt _______ (tire) after the chores.
The music concert was _______ (excite).
We were _______ (amuse) by Manya's dance.
Digging in the garden is _______ (exhaust).

data.speaker: manya
data.text: I forgot my boots in the city! If I had remembered my boots, I would not have dirtied my feet. This is the Conditional Type 3!

rules.title: The Formula of the Past
rules.formula: If + had + V3 ... would have + V3
rules.explainA: The condition uses 'had' plus the past participle.
rules.explainB: The result uses 'would have' plus the past participle.
rules.teacherNote: We use this for things that DID NOT happen. It is a regret.

questions.prompt: Complete: If Manya (prepare) _______, he would have enjoyed the trip.
Complete: If Polly had flown faster, she (reach) _______ early.
Complete: If we (have) _______ money, we would have bought a gift.
questions.hint: PLE TRAP: Use 'had had' when the verb is 'have'.

questions.prompt: Complete: If Kiki (catch) _______ the mouse, she would have eaten it.
Complete: They _______ (be) happy if the bash had commenced.

data.speaker: kiki
data.text: Look at me! I am cooking the food. In the Passive Voice, we say: The food is being cooked by me!

rules.title: Present Continuous Shift
rules.exampleB: The cow is being milked by Manya.
rules.explainA: Manya is the one doing the action.
rules.explainB: The cow is receiving the action. Use 'being' + V3.
rules.teacherNote: UNEB loves 'being' in the continuous passive voice!

questions.prompt: Change to Passive: Polly is eating a mango.
questions.expected: A mango is being eaten by Polly

questions.prompt: Change to Passive: The boys are playing football.
questions.expected: Football is being played by the boys

questions.prompt: Change to Passive: Kiki is mopping the floor.
questions.expected: The floor is being mopped by Kiki

media.content: THE FRUITFUL VISIT Last week, Manya visited his grandparents' farm in the rural area of Masaka. He found his relatives busy with various chores. His aunt was peeling matooke while his uncle was vaccinating the cattle. Manya was very interested in the process. He realized that if he had come earlier, he would have helped with the harvest. They ended the day with a small family bash under the big mango tree.
